articles.principle: Right to life, liberty and security of person
articles.application: Protection against arbitrary state infringement and state-sponsored violence

articles.principle: Absolute prohibition of torture and cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment
articles.application: Direct legal status of torture episodes starting from August 18, 1997 (Case No. 1-568/98)

articles.principle: Protection against arbitrary arrest, detention or exile
articles.application: Nullification of arbitrary detention starting August 5, 1997 (Judge Ciachir, name distortion)

articles.principle: Right to property and prohibition of arbitrary deprivation
articles.application: Mandatory restitutio in integrum for ZhSK-39, apt. 64 / Miron Costin 13/3

international_conventions.instrument: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties (VCLT)
international_conventions.effect: Nullity ab initio of any national judicial decision attempting to validate or sanitize torture or property theft through procedural bad faith.

international_conventions.instrument: UN Convention Against Torture and Other Cruel, Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment
international_conventions.effect: Obligation to prosecute, universal jurisdiction, and inadmissibility of statements extracted under torture.

legal_foundations.erga_omnes_obligations: Absolute and non-derogable obligations owed by the State to the international community as a whole.
